headline: Renewable Energy Gains Spark Debate on Public Land Use
summary: Voices split between celebrating renewable energy milestones and warning about fossil fuel expansion on public lands, while others address climate disaster coverage and eco-anxiety.

voices.quote: Distributed solar has a lot of downsides relative to the existing power systems in the West but it’s a huge winner in Africa that’s going to transform hundreds of millions of lives.

Solar power also continues to skyrocket in Texas, with generation up 31% compared to last year

Over the last twelve months, solar has made up 12.2% of Texas' electricity, a record high!
"Go Woke, Go Broke"? Texas Runs on Renewables Now
